name: skills
description: Agent skills for product work: drafting and critiquing PRDs, critiquing specs and implementation plans before execution, and running qualitative user-research interviews.

plugins.name: product-critique
plugins.description: Critique product planning artifacts before execution: a spec/design-doc reviewer and an implementation-plan reviewer. Findings come back as concrete proposed edits.

plugins.name: qualitative-product-research
plugins.description: Qualitative user-research skills: rehearse interviews with a coached roleplay, and get live next-question suggestions during a real interview.

plugins.name: product-development
plugins.description: Turn a product idea into a PRD ready for the spec: get grilled on the idea first, get a product-only draft (what and why), then critique it into proposed edits. Prototype or critique UIs against the Laws of UX.
